name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.6 degrees north of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 6 visits over 64 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 36 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.7 days starting 2025-09-01, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.41 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
